events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWSJU

The National Weather Service in San Juan has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Mona Passage Southward to 17N...

* Until 345 PM AST.

* At 249 PM AST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located over the Mona Passage, moving west at 10
knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* The severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.

events.region: Carroll, IN; Clinton, IN; Tippecanoe, IN
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Clinton County in central Indiana...
Southwestern Carroll County in north central Indiana...
Southeastern Tippecanoe County in west central Indiana...

* WHEN...Until 630 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 232 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.25 and 1.5 inches of
rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Lafayette, Frankfort, Rossville, Shadeland, Dayton, Mulberry
and Clarks Hill.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
